method: Prompt-led editorial examples authored before matching; first-pass everyday answers plus a separate pass of common concepts and natural/regional wording. Duplicate identical inputs per question removed. This is a regression challenge set, not a representative sample of players or all valid answers.
claim: Every reviewed challenge input passes. The cases establish an editorial acceptance benchmark; they do not establish a player-weighted or all-possible-answer coverage percentage.
corrections: Added missing Jordan and accepted Caspian inland-sea coasts under an explicit scope.
Preserved all previous canonical names, aliases and scores.
Mapped ordinary inflections, regional terms and natural phrases explicitly; no substring or online AI acceptance.
Snapshot-owned exactRejections prevents Zambia becoming Gambia on new coastline captures. Captured old rules and points remain fixed.
Shortened three scopes to avoid an answer giveaway and clarify geographic membership.
limitations: Cases were authored and reviewed by the implementing assistant, not an independent player study.
Lists remain finite. Passing all reviewed examples does not prove acceptance of most conceivable valid answers.
Familiarity ratings are editorial estimates, not measured popularity.
